regions.label: <house 1>
regions.prompt: Two-story coastal-style house with light beige travertine stone walls featuring horizontal banding and crisp white trim. The complex roofline features dark shingles and multiple gables with decorative white trusses. On the image-right and image-left, gabled dormers with white columns and a sunburst-patterned truss shelter windows. A set of gray stairs with black railings and white posts leads up to a porch. Windows are white-framed with multi-pane grids; three are visible on the upper level and four on the lower level, some glowing with warm interior light. A white horizontal band separates the two floors. The house sits on a light gray foundation over a flat green lawn.

regions.label: <roof 1>
regions.prompt: Multi-gabled roof with dark charcoal shingles and thick white fascia boards. Two prominent forward-facing gables feature white decorative truss patterns with vertical and diagonal braces in their peaks. The gable on the image-left sits above a small white-framed window, while the larger gable on the image-right covers a set of three white-framed windows. A lower, horizontal roof section with matching dark shingles extends across the bottom center, sheltering a porch area. All roof edges are sharply defined by the white trim against the dark textured shingles.

regions.label: <porch 1>
regions.prompt: Front porch with a gabled dark-shingled roof and a white decorative sunburst truss in the gable peak. Two square white columns with decorative capitals support the roof, resting on a light-gray stone foundation. A white front door with six glass panes and a black handle is recessed behind the columns. Black railings with thin vertical balusters line the porch edge and the light-gray concrete steps leading up to it. The railings are punctuated by white square posts with pyramid-shaped caps. To the image-right, the house wall features light beige travertine stone with horizontal banding and two white-trimmed windows.

regions.label: <stairs 1>
regions.prompt: A set of light-gray concrete stairs leading up to a porch landing. The stairs are flanked by black metal railings with thin vertical spindles. White square wooden posts with pyramid-shaped caps anchor the railings at the base of the stairs, the landing, and the top of the first flight. The landing and stairs are part of a house with a light-gray textured foundation and light beige travertine stone with horizontal banding visible in the background.

regions.label: <window 1>
regions.prompt: Three identical, side-by-side vertical rectangular windows set into a light beige travertine stone wall. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into twelve small panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-four grid. The glass panes are dark grey with subtle vertical reflections.

regions.label: <window 4>
regions.prompt: A trio of identical, vertically oriented rectangular windows set side-by-side. Each window features a thick white frame and is divided into nine smaller panes by thin white muntins in a three-by-three grid. The glass panes are dark gray with subtle vertical reflections. The windows are mounted against a wall of light beige travertine stone with horizontal banding.

regions.label: <window 2>
regions.prompt: White-framed rectangular window with six panes arranged in two columns and three rows, separated by thin white muntins. The glass panes are dark and non-reflective. A thick white sill projects slightly from the bottom of the frame against a background of light beige travertine stone with horizontal banding.

regions.label: <window 5>
regions.prompt: Vertical rectangular window with a thick white frame and sill, set against light beige travertine stone with horizontal banding. The window is divided into two sashes: the top sash contains six panes in a three-by-two grid glowing with warm yellow light, while the bottom sash contains six dark panes in a matching three-by-two grid.

regions.label: <window 7>
regions.prompt: Tall, narrow rectangular window with a thick white frame and prominent sill, set against light beige travertine stone with horizontal banding. The window is divided vertically; the image-left pane glows with a warm golden light and is subdivided by thin white muntins, while the image-right pane is a single, dark grey glass surface.

regions.label: <plain 1>
regions.prompt: A flat, grassy plain. A long shadow is cast onto the grass at the image-left. In the background, the plain rises into a gentle, smooth hill that spans the width of the frame under a clear, pale sky.

regions.label: <shadow 1>
regions.prompt: A dark, elongated shadow cast across a textured, olive-green grassy field. The shadow's upper edge forms a large, solid geometric block that angles from the top-left towards the center. Below this, thinner, parallel horizontal bands of shadow stretch across the lower half of the crop, with the bottom-most band featuring a serrated, comb-like edge on its right side.

regions.label: <sky 1>
regions.prompt: Clear, pale blue sky with a subtle horizontal gradient, transitioning from a slightly deeper blue at the top to a very pale, almost white hue near the horizon line. The sky is completely cloudless and uniform in texture.

The first floor includes a covered <porch 1> with white columns and a white-trimmed gabled roof. A set of <stairs 1> with black metal railings and white posts leads up to the <porch 1> entrance.

The <house 1> has numerous white-framed windows. On the second floor, a group of three <window 1> panes is located on the image-right gable, and a single <window 2> is centered under the image-left gable. A small <window 3> is visible on the far image-left side of the second floor. On the first floor, another group of three <window 4> panes is positioned on the image-right side, behind the <porch 1>. A single <window 5> is centered on the image-left side of the first floor, with two more <window 6> and <window 7> panes further to the image-left.
